slices.S1: The accepted plan contains 20 tickets. Core identity/schema/policies are released; seed idempotency and synthetic admission are verified. Gateway/CSP/runtime configuration and browser PKCE preparation are merged and released. Role-authority and admin-recovery evidence are in review. The owner elected to keep the sole dev admin. Auth remains disabled; native fixture creation, actual Google federation, measured p99, live E2E and remaining role-specific shell acceptance are outstanding.

S1-01.notes: Cognito pool, Google IdP, clients and typed configuration are merged and synth-tested. The dev secret, matching Google client ID and saved redirect URI were verified. Read-only review verified the three basic identity scopes and External/Testing audience. Auth is disabled and no pool is deployed; activation and live federation verification remain.

S1-02.notes: Owner accepted ADR-0008–0011 on 2026-10-11; decisions are merged in all three repositories. Live binding and latency proof are separate S1-18 acceptance work.

S1-03.notes: Backend and infra are merged and released in dev execution 7c97ec40-371c-4387-8c26-817c75450d4c. The arm64 live alias is READY with reserved concurrency 1 and provisioned concurrency 1/1. A synthetic uninvited Google event returned SIGN_UP_NOT_ALLOWED; the decision log had only safe fields and no email. Policy and PostgreSQL tests pass. The single 66 ms sample is not p99 proof; actual federated acceptance and measured cold/warm p99 remain. The pipeline build-list bootstrap issue was repaired before release. Two provisioned cold initialization samples were 2805.16 and 3057.93 ms; these small samples do not establish p99.

S1-04.notes: Identity migration and sqlc lookups are merged and applied on dev; PostgreSQL lifecycle, uniqueness and idempotency tests pass.

S1-15.notes: Trusted authorizer claims are carried through the Lambda adapter and released to dev. Protected-route integration remains S1-06/S1-14.

S1-17.notes: presignup_ro bootstrap and exact SELECT grants on users/invitations are merged and deployed. Negative privilege tests cover writes and unrelated future tables; the deployed trigger uses its scoped IAM connection.

S1-10.notes: Frontend #21 is merged and released successfully in ab156fe8-0a32-420e-b18c-48a2b6dcc691.
